t: You're looking at 1 to 11 New Square, a row of seventeenth-century legal chambers in Lincoln's Inn. Nicholas Barbon designed it. He was an English physician, property developer and financier, and he's regarded as one of the first economists. He also brought several new ideas to financial markets and insurance. So the man who laid out these lawyers' rooms was a developer and a thinker about money as much as a builder, which is worth keeping in mind as you look along the frontage.
